body:
This was my first time drinking poppy seed tea and first time with opioids. Had some experience with 1 one Solpadine tablet when I served my time in army, it contained 8mg codeine - had little buzz from it and good help for my ankle pain.
I bought seeds from online whole sale site - 1kg (2.2 pounds). I also searched some of the local stores but didn't see none. Color of the seeds is dark blue/black, some lonely grains are brownish - country of origin Czech (For info, I'm from Europe).
Other reports suggested that wholesale seeds are probably much potent than supermarket stuff, so I started just with 250 grams of seeds, that's about 0.55 pounds. To mix that stuff I used 2 liter Coca-Cola bottle, added seeds 250g, about 300ml warm tap water (just to cover seeds) and about 2 tablespoon lemon juice - regular extract form that little yellow bottle :)
Set timer for 15min and started rapidly shake that bottle, after 2min I was tired, so I continued by slowly turning the bottle side to side with one hand and read more some reports. After 15 min poured content out, didn't use any filter, just slowly opend bottle cap and gave some pressure to the bottle, until most of the yellow brownish liquid (tea) was out (about 250 ml).
Drinking and timings.
00:00 - I was afraid that it will be too strong as taste was very strong, so I just drank only half what I got. Taste was shit, used big shots.
00:20 - I wasn't sure if it was working as I was a little excited and nervous.
00:30 - Seems like smt is happening, I start to feel warm, laziness.
00:40 - I now feel that morfine buzz that everybody is talking about, pleasant feeling. A little numbness, it feels as if my body weight is increased.
00:50 - I feel good, very good. I check my eyes, - movement, breathing (all seems under control). High is good but not too much, so I decide to drink other half of the tea.
01:00 - High peaks did arrive around that time and I was very happy with it. By that time I had one side effect - itching. But it was very pleasant itchiness, just little scratch here and there.
This high lasted around 10h. I drink it kind of late 9:00PM so the end of that high was spent in I bed, very sleepy watching youtube etc. Had very good rest, but didn't sleep much.
Side effects. (Next morning, 12 hours later - writing this).
1. I look like shit, eyelids are very dark.
2. I still have that itchiness.
3. For my surprise, after I drink some orange juice - got some stomach cramps and body wanted to puke. I hold it back as I really don't want to do it. But overall feeling is good.
Overall experience is positive, for example compared to alcohol and its side effects - if I want to get similar level euphoria.
Warning!
If I had used volumes that I read from other reports (1kg or 2 pounds), there is chance that I would be dead by now. At least with that potency I have here and taking account my personal metabolism to opioids.
It the end, Weed its da best thing there, this shit is for experimenting etc.
